name: Village of Elmsford
gaps: Elmsford has no dimensional schedule: rules are spread across §§ 335-4 to 335-17
No building or impervious coverage limit for one-family homes in R-0/R-1/R-2 (county lists 30%/40%; the code only caps accessory buildings at 30%/40% of the required rear yard)
Side yards in R-0/R-1/R-2 scale with lot width; the recorded figures are the caps reached at 60 ft (R-0/R-1) or 50 ft (R-2) of width
R-3 recorded values are the multifamily controls; the code sets no side/rear yards for one-family homes in R-3
No min lot width/depth beyond street-frontage rules; no stories limit in R-0 to R-2 (height in feet only)
No ADU provision found (R-2 two-family conversions by special permit instead); no local steep-slope or tree-removal law found in the chapter list

wetlands.summary: Ch. 179: the Village administers the NYS Freshwater Wetlands Act locally for DEC-mapped wetlands and the adjacent area up to 100 ft from their boundary; compliance is required before a building permit.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 288: SWPPP and permit for land development disturbing 1 acre or more (or part of a larger common plan).

general.accessory_structures: Not in required front or side yards; in the rear yard up to 30% (R-0/R-1) or 40% (R-2) of the required rear yard, 3 ft from lot lines unless fireproof, 3 ft from the house, max 2 stories (1 story within 6 ft of a lot line); corner lots 10 ft from the side street (§ 335-4N-P).
general.pools: Ch. 295: permit with plot plan; 4 ft fence (or pool cover) for private pools; no zoning setback stated.
general.notes: Open porches/entrances up to one story may project 8 ft into the front yard (§ 335-4J). Garage space limited to one car per 5,000 sf of lot, max two (§ 335-5B).

R-0.name: Residence R-O One Family

max_floor_area.note: § 335-4S FAR for one- and two-family dwellings in R-0 to R-3. Gross floor area excludes decks, patios, unenclosed porches, garages and unfinished basements; spaces over 16 ft high count twice

accessory.notes: Accessory buildings may not sit in required front or side yards; in the rear yard they may cover at most 30% of the required rear yard, must be 3 ft from lot lines unless fireproof, 3 ft from the house, max 2 stories (1 story within 6 ft of a lot line); on corner lots 10 ft from the side street line (§ 335-4N-P)

R-0.source: § 335-4F(2)-(3) lot area/frontage; § 335-14A height; § 335-15A front; § 335-16A rear; § 335-17A side; § 335-4S FAR
R-0.notes: Lot at least 1/2 acre with 50 ft frontage on a 30 ft street. Side yards scale with lot width: 5 ft each / 12 ft both at 40 ft or less, +1 in. each and +3 in. combined per foot of width, capped at 60 ft width (6 ft 8 in. / 17 ft, recorded). Front yard is a 20 ft mean depth, more where the block has a uniform deeper alignment (max 40 ft).

R-1.name: Residence R-1 One Family

max_floor_area.note: § 335-4S FAR for one- and two-family dwellings in R-0 to R-3. Gross floor area excludes decks, patios, unenclosed porches, garages and unfinished basements; spaces over 16 ft high count twice

accessory.notes: Accessory buildings may not sit in required front or side yards; in the rear yard they may cover at most 30% of the required rear yard, must be 3 ft from lot lines unless fireproof, 3 ft from the house, max 2 stories (1 story within 6 ft of a lot line); on corner lots 10 ft from the side street line (§ 335-4N-P)

R-1.source: § 335-4F(2)-(3) lot area/frontage; § 335-14A height; § 335-15A front; § 335-16A rear; § 335-17A side; § 335-4S FAR
R-1.notes: Lot at least 5,000 sf with 50 ft frontage on a 30 ft street. Side yards scale with lot width: 5 ft each / 12 ft both at 40 ft or less, +1 in. each and +3 in. combined per foot of width, capped at 60 ft width (6 ft 8 in. / 17 ft, recorded). Front yard is a 20 ft mean depth, more where the block has a uniform deeper alignment (max 40 ft).

R-2.name: Residence R-2 Two Families

max_floor_area.note: § 335-4S FAR for one- and two-family dwellings in R-0 to R-3. Gross floor area excludes decks, patios, unenclosed porches, garages and unfinished basements; spaces over 16 ft high count twice

accessory.notes: Accessory buildings may not sit in required front or side yards; in the rear yard they may cover at most 40% of the required rear yard, must be 3 ft from lot lines unless fireproof, 3 ft from the house, max 2 stories (1 story within 6 ft of a lot line); on corner lots 10 ft from the side street line (§ 335-4N-P)

R-2.notes: One-family lot 5,000 sf / 50 ft frontage; two-family by Village Board special permit on 10,000 sf with 100 ft width. Side yard 5 ft at 25 ft width or less, +1 in. per foot of width up to 50 ft (7 ft 1 in., recorded), +2 in. per foot of height over 40 ft. Rear yard 20 ft plus 4 in. per foot of height over 30 ft.

R-3.name: Residence R-3 Three or More Families

max_floor_area.note: § 335-4S FAR for one- and two-family dwellings in R-0 to R-3. Gross floor area excludes decks, patios, unenclosed porches, garages and unfinished basements; spaces over 16 ft high count twice

accessory.notes: Accessory buildings may not sit in required front or side yards; in the rear yard they may cover at most 40% of the required rear yard, must be 3 ft from lot lines unless fireproof, 3 ft from the house, max 2 stories (1 story within 6 ft of a lot line); on corner lots 10 ft from the side street line (§ 335-4N-P)

R-3.notes: Recorded values are the multifamily rules (2,500 sf of land per unit, 25% coverage, 2.5 stories/35 ft, front 20, rear 30, sides 15/30). General R-3 height cap is 48 ft (§ 335-14A(2)). One- and two-family uses are allowed as in R-1/R-2 (§ 335-7A), but §§ 335-16/17 set no rear/side yards for R-3 one-family homes.

RCD.name: Residential Cluster Development

max_floor_area.note: Residential FAR excluding parking and mechanical space

RCD.notes: 4-acre minimum site, 2,500 sf of gross site area per unit, 20% affordable units. Yards are a 20 ft setback from any perimeter lot line of the RCD site and 50 ft from any off-site residence; building spacing 15-60 ft by wall orientation; max building length 150 ft. Existing houses on 5,000+ sf lots follow R-2 rules.
